prompt:
Goal: Create a desktop screenshot-like collage showing 10 AI-generated recruitment poster variations for a Chinese tech company, all with nearly identical purple-and-white branding and a cute rabbit mascot, arranged above a prompt input bar.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white interface screenshot, about 1064×922 px. Leave generous white margins. The image area occupies the upper 80%, and a rounded prompt composer bar sits centered along the bottom.

Main layout: Arrange exactly 10 square poster thumbnails in a loose grid with slight spacing, as if displayed in an image-generation results gallery. Count and placement of thumbnails: 3 posters across the top row; 4 posters across the middle row; 3 posters across the bottom row. Each poster is a clean Chinese recruitment flyer with the same core visual identity but small layout variations.

Poster design shared by all 10 thumbnails: Use a light lavender-to-white background, deep purple and bright blue typography, rounded cards, small icons, thin dividers, soft shadows, and a polished SaaS/AI startup aesthetic. Every poster should feature the logo text 兔子 AI near the top, a large bold Chinese headline 兔子 AI 继续招聘 全栈开发实习生, and multiple information blocks resembling a job description. Use readable-looking Chinese microtext but it may be partially too small to read at thumbnail size. Include iconography such as gift boxes, graduation caps, location pins, calendars, code brackets, laptop icons, check marks, and circular badges.

Mascot subject: Include a cute white 3D rabbit mascot in most posters, with pink inner ears, glossy black eyes, a friendly smile, and a purple hoodie or shirt branded with the company name. Vary the mascot pose across the 10 posters: sitting with a laptop, waving, giving a thumbs-up, peeking from the bottom edge, wearing round glasses, and standing beside cards. The rabbit should feel like a friendly AI assistant mascot.

Poster content blocks: Each thumbnail should show several compact recruitment sections, including exactly these recurring block types across the designs: recruitment target, requirements, job location, internship participation/work content, work arrangement, and benefits. Some posters may have a purple CTA strip or footer, small QR-code-like square, or decorative code panel, but keep all poster variants visually consistent.

Bottom prompt composer UI: At the bottom center, draw a large rounded white input box with soft shadow, resembling an AI image generation chat bar. Inside it show the gray placeholder text 描述你想要创建的图片. Along the lower edge of the bar include small UI icons and controls: image icon, grid icon, book icon, @ symbol, a dropdown labeled image, a model label gpt2 with tiny green signal bars, a dropdown reading auto / 1K / auto, a count selector showing 10个, and a paper-plane send button on the far right. Add a three-dot menu at the top-right of the composer.

Visual style: Clean modern Chinese AI-product interface screenshot, soft pastel lavender, white, cobalt blue, and purple. The 10 posters should look like outputs from the same prompt: highly consistent layout, typography, colors, and mascot styling, with only minor differences in composition. Use crisp vector-like UI, subtle gradients, rounded rectangles, and high-resolution details.

Constraints: The collage must contain exactly 10 poster thumbnails and one bottom prompt composer bar. Do not add people, photos, watermarks, browser chrome, or extra panels. Keep the overall impression that the AI generated many nearly identical recruitment poster options.

promptZh:
目标：创建一个类似桌面截图的拼贴图，展示 10 款为一家中国科技公司生成的 AI 招聘海报变体，所有海报均采用几乎相同的紫白配色方案和可爱的兔子吉祥物，并排列在一个提示词输入栏上方。

画布：宽屏 16:9 白色界面截图，尺寸约为 1064×922 像素。留出充足的白色边距。图像区域占据上方 80%，底部居中放置一个圆角提示词输入栏。

主要布局：将 10 个正方形海报缩略图以松散的网格形式排列，并留有微小间距，如同显示在图像生成结果库中。缩略图的数量和位置：顶行 3 张海报；中间行 4 张海报；底行 3 张海报。每张海报都是一张简洁的中文招聘传单，具有相同的核心视觉识别度，但布局略有不同。

10 个缩略图共享的海报设计：使用浅薰衣草色到白色的背景，深紫色和亮蓝色的排版，圆角卡片，小图标，细分隔线，柔和的阴影，以及精致的 SaaS/AI 初创公司美学。每张海报顶部附近应包含徽标文本 兔子 AI，一个醒目的大号中文标题 兔子 AI 继续招聘 全栈开发实习生，以及多个类似于职位描述的信息块。使用看起来可读的中文微型文字，但在缩略图尺寸下可能部分无法辨认。包含图标，如礼盒、学士帽、位置标记、日历、代码括号、笔记本电脑图标、勾选标记和圆形徽章。

吉祥物主体：在大多数海报中加入一个可爱的白色 3D 兔子吉祥物，粉色的内耳，亮黑色的眼睛，友好的微笑，以及一件印有公司名称的紫色连帽衫或衬衫。在 10 张海报中变换吉祥物的姿势：坐着使用笔记本电脑、挥手、竖起大拇指、从底部边缘探出头、戴着圆框眼镜以及站在卡片旁边。这只兔子应该给人一种友好的 AI Agent 吉祥物的感觉。

海报内容块：每个缩略图应显示几个紧凑的招聘部分，包括在所有设计中重复出现的以下块类型：招聘目标、任职要求、工作地点、实习参与/工作内容、工作安排和福利待遇。部分海报可能包含紫色 CTA 条或页脚、类似二维码的小方块或装饰性代码面板，但要保持所有海报变体在视觉上的一致性。

底部提示词输入界面：在底部中心，绘制一个带有柔和阴影的大型圆角白色输入框，类似于 AI 图像生成聊天栏。在其中显示灰色占位符文本 描述你想要创建的图片。在输入栏的下边缘包含小 UI 图标和控件：图像图标、网格图标、书籍图标、@ 符号、标记为“图像”的下拉菜单、带有微小绿色信号条的模型标签 gpt2、显示为 auto / 1K / auto 的下拉菜单、显示为 10个 的数量选择器，以及最右侧的纸飞机发送按钮。在输入栏的右上角添加一个三点菜单。

视觉风格：简洁现代的中文 AI 产品界面截图，柔和的淡薰衣草色、白色、钴蓝色和紫色。这 10 张海报看起来应像是来自同一个提示词的输出：高度一致的布局、排版、颜色和吉祥物造型，仅在构图上有细微差别。使用清晰的矢量风格 UI、微妙的渐变、圆角矩形和高分辨率细节。

约束：拼贴图必须恰好包含 10 个海报缩略图和一个底部提示词输入栏。不要添加人物、照片、水印、浏览器边框或额外的面板。保持整体印象，即 AI 生成了许多几乎相同的招聘海报选项。
